name: Lusha
summary: Search B2B contacts and companies, then reveal emails, phones and firmographics for the ones you pick.

api_key.description: A Lusha API key (Lusha dashboard > API settings). Sent in the api_key header.

notes: This entry covers the v3 API (the v2 endpoints are legacy).
Two steps: search or prospecting returns a no-PII preview and ids; enrich reveals emails and phones and spends credits.
Almost every call is a POST with a JSON body.
Tables (and the tableId option that writes results into one), subscriptions (webhooks), signals, lookalikes, ICP scoring and audit-log endpoints are not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Get account usage
endpoints.summary: Credits (total, used, remaining), rate limits, plan and the credit cost per action.
notes: Limited to 5 requests per minute. Its pricing section lists the credit cost of each action.

endpoints.name: Search contacts by identifier
endpoints.summary: Non-PII preview of up to 100 contacts: which data points exist and what revealing costs.

contacts.description: Up to 100 objects; each carries one identifier: id, linkedinUrl, email, or firstName+lastName with companyName or companyDomain; optional clientReferenceId.

signals.description: {types (required), startDate, maxResultsPerSignal}: narrow to contacts with recent activity such as a job change.

notes: A read over POST: nothing in your account is changed.
Returns no emails or phones; use contacts.enrich with the returned ids. Charged per successful result (the api_search action).

endpoints.name: Reveal emails and phones for found contacts
endpoints.summary: Unlock contact data for ids returned by search or prospecting.

ids.description: Up to 100 contact ids from a search response.

reveal.description: What to unlock: emails, phones. Omit for both.

waterfallEnabled.description: Set false to skip third-party waterfall providers for this call. Defaults to true when Data Waterfall is on for the account.

notes: A read over POST: nothing in your account is changed.
Spends credits per revealed field; billing.creditsCharged in the answer is the total.
With Data Waterfall enabled, results may carry a job; poll lusha.contacts.job.

endpoints.name: Find contacts and reveal their data in one call
endpoints.summary: Search plus reveal for up to 100 contacts.

contacts.description: Up to 100 objects; each carries one identifier: id, linkedinUrl, email, or firstName+lastName with companyName or companyDomain; optional clientReferenceId.

notes: A read over POST: nothing in your account is changed.
Two charges: one per search (api_search) and one per revealed field; billing.creditsCharged is the total.
Data Waterfall runs automatically when enabled; this call never returns a job.

endpoints.name: Get a waterfall enrich job
endpoints.summary: Poll the async job returned by contacts.enrich.
notes: While status is processing, wait retryAfter seconds and poll again. Polling is free.

endpoints.name: Prospect contacts by ICP filters
endpoints.summary: Search contacts by title, seniority, department, location and company attributes.

filters.description: {contacts: {include, exclude}, companies: {include, exclude}}. Contact keys include jobTitles, seniorityIds, departments, countries, locations, existingDataPoints; company keys include names, domains, sizes, revenues, technologies, industriesLabels, intentTopics. Valid values come from the prospecting filter endpoints.

notes: A read over POST: nothing in your account is changed.
Charged per result (api_search), plus a charge per matched signal when signals are requested. No emails or phones; use contacts.enrich.

endpoints.name: Get valid contact filter values
endpoints.summary: Allowed values for a contact filter type.

filterType.description: departments, seniority, existingDataPoints, countries or locations.

query.description: Text to match; required (2 to 256 characters) for locations.

endpoints.name: Search companies by identifier

companies.description: Up to 100 objects, each with id, name or domain, plus optional clientReferenceId.

notes: A read over POST: nothing in your account is changed.
Charged per successful result (api_search).

endpoints.name: Enrich companies
endpoints.summary: Full company data for ids returned by search or prospecting.

ids.description: Up to 100 company ids from search results.

reveal.description: Extra premium fields (for example employeesByDepartment, directParent, ultimateParent); each is charged separately per result.

notes: A read over POST: nothing in your account is changed.
Charged per successful result (reveal_company), plus per revealed field.

endpoints.name: Find companies and reveal their data in one call
endpoints.summary: Search plus enrich for up to 100 companies.

companies.description: Up to 100 objects, each with id, name or domain.

reveal.description: Premium fields to unlock; they are never returned by default.

notes: A read over POST: nothing in your account is changed.
Charged per successful result (reveal_company), plus one charge per revealed field.

endpoints.name: Prospect companies by filters
endpoints.summary: Search companies by size, revenue, industry, technology, location, intent and signals.

filters.description: {companies: {include (required), exclude}, contacts: {include, exclude}} with keys such as names, domains, sizes, revenues, technologies, mainIndustriesIds, sicCodes, naicsCodes, locations, intentTopics.

notes: A read over POST: nothing in your account is changed.
Charged per result (api_search), plus a charge per matched signal when signals are requested.
